full_details: At eight Richard Quiney spoke from the Bell. The town's paper is before the men who can grant it, and he looks for an answer on Monday. Supper is Monday at six, at the Bell. He will stand the wine if the answer is yes, and you will if it is no. You refused to bring fellows with a charitable purse. You did not ask him for the two pounds, and you did not pay a brief. When the call was done you laughed without a sound, because Anne's letter was in your head, and you did not say so to him. Late in the morning you wrote three sheets and did not finish them. Six tradesmen meet to cast a play. The weaver would be the lover, the lady, and the lion. The head is not on the paper. The afternoon was the Shrew, and you were in it, and the part was not named. The reckoning was eight-and-twenty shillings, said once. Monday had been the Queen's. At the Jackdaw you laid the three sheets by Kemp's trencher and went on with your eggs. He read them standing. At the tyrant's line he roared once, and Agnes Tipping's jug went. He sat and read them again. He said the weaver would play the whole of it and be loved, that it was himself, and he said thou. It was the first thou. You said you had put in the best of him. You told him that in the third act the man is given an ass's head and a queen falls in love with him. He laughed and spilled, and he was charged double. Dinner is sixpence. Garnish closed his book on the tally. The play is not finished. You named no day for the rest of it.
one_sentence: Quiney set Monday supper at six, you wrote three sheets and stopped, and at the Jackdaw Kemp said thou.
title: Kemp said thou, once
